findings.title: Inventory entry omits pinned inputDocuments validation
findings.trigger: After authentic P36/P37 receipts exist, protected-pins.json (or another metadata input) changes while plan/contract/tool/artifact seal files remain unchanged.
findings.behavior: inventory checks plan/contract hashes and 13 runtime/reference files, but directly reads protected-pins/source-ledger/expected-outputs without checking their hashes recorded in the exact contract. For example deleting a row from protected-pins removes its immutable-file check without causing a document-pin refusal.
findings.impact: P37 can silently use a reduced immutable-file protection list despite claiming the original sealed plan boundary. No current shared mutation or forged acceptance was performed.
findings.minimumFix: In inventory replace bundle();protected();ledger=source_state('after') with _,ledger=validate(plan_sha,contract_sha,initial=False,dependencies=False), or equivalently pin all contract inputDocuments before reading them. Preserve all existing final/authority/material/command guards.
findings.regression: Bounded check: mutation of a copied protected-pins document must be rejected by its contract hash; static control-flow confirms P37 reaches the same post-install validate path. No successful fake supervisor receipt is required.
